description: Data underlying the publication: Fundamental study on the influence of dynamic load and distributed energy resources on power system short-term voltage stability is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Aleksandar Boricic. STVS method is utilized to analyze the impact of distributed energy resources and dynamic load on power system stability. The repository contains the publication, code, explanation, and the model that can be used. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: PDF. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
